findings.title: Ride-through is the real value
findings.text: 10 of 10 mains events ridden through with the inverter in UPS mode, against 1 without it: without it the 24 V collapses and 60 min of production are lost this month.

findings.title: The reserve wins over peak shaving
findings.text: The import went over the 70 W cap in 581 of 2880 quarter-hours; in 581 of them the battery was at its 30% ride-through reserve, which the EMS will not spend. The worst, 84 W, came on day 13 at 07:00. A bigger battery, or a smaller reserve, would shave it; keeping the cell running through an outage was chosen instead.

findings.title: Demand response met with the battery
findings.text: All three events held under 15 W import (21.9 Wh in total), with production running; without the battery the cell imported 268.2 Wh in the same windows.

findings.title: The energy bill alone does not pay for it
findings.text: EUR 8.21 a month saved on EUR 1365 spent: 14 years. The cell draws tens of watts; the case rests on ride-through, demand response and the data.

findings.title: A clogged cabinet filter costs the PSU 31 % of its life
findings.text: At this month's temperatures the PSU's capacitors last 58.2 years with the filter work orders and 40.3 years without: 3 filter changes, all in the night gap.
